title: Add flat shipping fee with free shipping threshold
body:
## Summary

Orders under 50.00 pay a flat 4.99 shipping fee. Orders above 50.00 ship free.

## Changes

* pricing adds a shipping amount to the total

## How to test

Check out a cart under 50.00 and one over 50.00.

verixa_should_cover: Cart under the threshold pays 4.99 shipping
Cart of exactly 50.00 should ship free (BUG: it is charged)
Cart over the threshold ships free
Existing checkout test expects no shipping and now fails (BUG: test not updated)
